name: DHL Shipment Tracking
description: Track DHL shipments worldwide using the official DHL Unified Tracking API. Get real-time shipment status, delivery events, and estimated delivery dates.
instructions:
Tracks DHL shipments through DHL's Shipment Tracking - Unified API (`api-eu.dhl.com/track/shipments`), which covers DHL Express, Parcel Germany (DHL Paket), eCommerce, Freight and other DHL services with one key. Every tool is read-only.

**Getting credentials**
1. Create an account at developer.dhl.com, then on the **Shipment Tracking - Unified** API page click **Get Access** (or **My Apps → Create App**) and add that API to an app.
2. DHL reviews the request. After approval, the app in **My Apps** shows an **API Key** (Consumer Key). Put it in `DHL_API_KEY`; it is sent in the `DHL-API-Key` header. The API Secret is not needed for tracking.

**Limits**: a new key may make 250 calls per day and at most 1 call every 5 seconds. Higher quotas are requested from DHL in the app's dashboard. Do not poll the same shipment over and over in one conversation.

**One tracking number per call**: DHL documents that the Unified API accepts only one tracking number per request and does not support batch tracking. A comma-separated list in `dhl_track_multiple_shipments` is therefore not resolved as a batch. Track each number with `dhl_track_shipment` instead, at least 5 seconds apart.

**Reading the response**: `shipments[]` can hold more than one match when a number exists in several DHL services; `service` on each entry says which (`express`, `parcel-de`, `ecommerce`, `freight` …). `status.statusCode` is one of `pre-transit`, `transit`, `delivered`, `failure` or `unknown`; `status.status` and `status.description` carry the readable text, and `events[]` holds the history, newest first. `estimatedTimeOfDelivery` appears only when the service provides it. Timestamps are ISO 8601; one without a time zone is local time at the event's location. `language` (e.g. `de`) is a preference only: the text comes back in that language when the service offers it.

**Not found**: HTTP 404 means DHL found no shipment for the number. Check the number for typos; a label that was only just created may not be trackable until DHL has scanned or registered the shipment. HTTP 401 means the key is missing, wrong or not yet approved.

**Cloud reachability**: `api-eu.dhl.com` is publicly reachable over HTTPS.

tools.name: dhl_track_shipment
tools.description: Track a DHL shipment by its tracking number. Returns the current status, all tracking events, and estimated delivery time. Supports DHL Express, DHL Parcel, DHL eCommerce, DHL Freight, and other DHL business units.

trackingNumber.description: The DHL tracking number (e.g. 7777777770 for DHL Parcel DE, 1234567890 for DHL Express)

language.description: ISO 639-1 language code for event descriptions (e.g. 'en', 'de'). Defaults to 'en'.

tools.name: dhl_track_multiple_shipments
tools.description: Track multiple DHL shipments at once by providing a comma-separated list of tracking numbers. Returns status and events for all shipments. Maximum 20 tracking numbers per request.

trackingNumbers.description: Comma-separated list of DHL tracking numbers (max 20)

language.description: ISO 639-1 language code for event descriptions. Defaults to 'en'.
